title: RiskTier
description: Risk-tier decision record for an AI or model use case in financial services. Consumed by model-card-builder, validation-plan, agentic-ai-controls, board-ai-risk-pack, genai-pre-prod-review, and the model inventory of record.

use_case_id.description: Canonical use-case ID. Links to the ai-use-case-intake record.

use_case_version.description: Intake-record version this tier was decided against.

engagement_scope_id.description: Links to engagement-scoping record if supplied.

function.description: Function, e.g., model risk, AI governance.

tier.description: Tier-1 = enterprise-material or customer-binding. Tier-4 = minimal exposure, monitor-only.

tier_rationale.description: Two to four sentences, regulator-readable. Names the dominant factors and why the tier is what it is.

factors.description: Per-factor scoring with justification. Every named factor is scored or marked n/a with a reason.

weight.description: Whether this factor drove the tier, supported it, or was secondary.

justification.description: One to three sentences. Cites a source where the score relies on a regulatory or firm-policy threshold.

source_reference.description: Pointer to the source for the score (intake field, regulatory citation, firm-policy reference).

triggered_gates.description: Gates the tier triggers. Each names the gate, the owner, the cadence, and the stop condition.

gate.description: e.g., independent validation, AI risk committee approval, pre-prod gate, vendor diligence.

stop_condition.description: What halts the use case if the gate fails.

validation_depth.description: Depth the validation-plan skill should consume.

committee_route.description: Named committee or function that owns approval (e.g., AI risk committee, model risk committee, business-line risk forum).

re_tiering_triggers.description: Named events that force a re-tier. Each carries a monitoring owner.

event.description: Concrete event, e.g., autonomy level change, customer-base expansion, vendor swap, RAG corpus scope change, regulatory change.

owner.description: Function that watches for the event.

detection_method.description: How the event is detected (monitoring metric, change-management notice, supervisory letter).

items.description: Sector and cross-cutting overlays applied (e.g., banking, insurance, capital-markets, payments-fintech, cyber, privacy, conduct).

ai_act_overlap.description: Whether the use case overlaps with EU AI Act high-risk categorisation. Formal AI Act classification is owned by ai-act-triage; this field is a routing flag.

dissent.description: Recorded dissent where the tier disagrees with sponsor or business-line proposal. Empty array if none.

position.description: What the dissent is (proposed tier, accepted tier, rationale).

open_questions.description: Items that could move the tier once resolved.

source.description: Document, system, person, intake field, or [evidence needed].

sector_overlay_notes.description: Sector-specific tier modifiers raised by the loaded sector overlay reference doc.
